import json
from fractions import Fraction as F

# Vectors as coefficient triples over (a, b, c)
u = (F(1), F(-2), F(3))
v = (F(2), F(3), F(-4))
d = tuple(vi - ui for ui, vi in zip(u, v))  # direction v - u

# Third point u + t*d must have zero a-coefficient: u_a + t*d_a = 0
if d[0] == 0:
    print("UNSUPPORTED")
else:
    t = -u[0] / d[0]
    w = tuple(ui + t * di for ui, di in zip(u, d))
    p, q = w[1], w[2]
    assert w[0] == 0
    # Verify: w lies on line through u and v (cross product of (w-u) and d is zero)
    wu = tuple(wi - ui for wi, ui in zip(w, u))
    cross = (wu[1]*d[2] - wu[2]*d[1],
             wu[2]*d[0] - wu[0]*d[2],
             wu[0]*d[1] - wu[1]*d[0])
    assert all(c == 0 for c in cross)
    print(json.dumps({
        "final_answer": f"({p}, {q})",
        "evidence": {"t": str(t), "direction": [str(x) for x in d],
                     "w": [str(x) for x in w]}
    }))
